def transform(grid):
    # Transform an outlined square into its diagonal-folded form.
    cells=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v]
    color=grid[cells[0][0]][cells[0][1]]
    r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)
    c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
    out=[[0]*len(grid[0]) for _ in grid]
    # observed form: bottom edge stays; left/right edges shift to diagonals,
    # upper edge is folded onto the top-left row segment.
    for r,c in cells:
        y=r-r0; x=c-c0
        h=r1-r0; w=c1-c0
        if y==0: # upper edge folds left along top row
            nc=c0+x-h
            nr=r0
        elif x==0: # left edge folds to rising diagonal
            nr=r0+y; nc=c0+y-h
        elif x==w: # right edge folds down-right diagonal
            nr=r0+y; nc=c0+y
        elif y==h: # bottom edge stays in place
            nr=r1; nc=c
        else: continue
        if 0<=nr<len(out) and 0<=nc<len(out[0]): out[nr][nc]=color
    return out
PY

def transform(grid):
    cells=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v]
    color=grid[cells[0][0]][cells[0][1]]
    r0=min(r for r,c in cells); r1=max(r for r,c in cells)
    c0=min(c for r,c in cells); c1=max(c for r,c in cells)
    h=r1-r0
    out=[[0]*len(grid[0]) for _ in grid]
    for r,c in cells:
        y=r-r0; x=c-c0
        nc=c0+x+y-h if y<h else c
        if 0<=nc<len(grid[0]): out[r][nc]=color
    return out
